metadata.description: Fairpolicy: thirty insurance agency back-office agents. Each reads files your agency system or carriers already export (policy lists, commission statements, receivables, licences), masks client identifiers before results reach the model, writes worklists locally and waits for a named person before anything is sent. None binds, cancels, endorses or advises on coverage.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-additional-insureds
plugins.description: Sorts additional insured, waiver of subrogation and primary/non-contributory requests: covered by the policy, needing a carrier endorsement, waiting on the carrier, or open too long. Never issues a certificate.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-book-valuation
plugins.description: Summarises your book of business for a valuation conversation: commission and premium in force, mix, revenue by carrier and line, largest clients, and concentration and missing-data figures to watch. Not an appraisal.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-carrier-appointments
plugins.description: Matches each producer's business to their carrier appointments by state: business with no appointment, after termination or while pending, and appointments unused for a year. Never applies for or ends an appointment.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-carrier-feed-errors
plugins.description: Reads your carrier download log: failed transactions, transactions unmatched in suspense, and carriers with no successful download for a week. Never re-runs a download or edits a policy.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-carrier-payables
plugins.description: Reconciles a carrier's agency-bill account current with the payables in your agency system: amounts that differ, items on one side only, and items past due. Drafts a reconciliation note; never pays the carrier.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-certificate-limits
plugins.description: Checks every certificate of insurance you issued against the policy behind it: not in force, limits overstated, additional insured or waiver shown without the endorsement, wrong dates, unknown policy. Never issues or sends a certificate.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-commercial-renewals
plugins.description: Builds a renewal timeline for every commercial policy expiring in the next 150 days and lists overdue milestones, milestones due this week and renewals on track. Never sends a submission or binds.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-commission-chargebacks
plugins.description: For every cancelled policy, works out the commission chargeback on the unearned premium, compares it with what the carrier took back, and flags overcharges, chargebacks still to come, chargebacks with no cancellation and producer shares not reversed. Never posts, pays or sends.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-commission-statements
plugins.description: Checks every line of your carriers' commission statements against the commission you expect on that policy (your schedule by carrier, line and new or renewal), and lists underpaid, overpaid, duplicate and unmatched lines. Drafts a commission inquiry; never posts or sends.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-contingency-bonus
plugins.description: Reads carrier experience reports against each carrier's contingency or profit-sharing grid: tier met, estimated bonus, premium needed for the next tier, loss headroom, and bonuses received below the estimate. Never moves business.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-cross-sell
plugins.description: Groups active policies by client and lists one-line accounts and line gaps your agency looks for, by producer. A review list for licensed staff; never contacts a client or recommends coverage.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-data-quality
plugins.description: Checks every active policy for the data that breaks downloads, renewals and certificates: wrong dates, no carrier or premium, missing or invalid VINs, missing address, ZIP or contact, no producer or account manager. Never edits your agency system.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-direct-agency-bill
plugins.description: Compares how each policy is coded (agency bill or direct bill) with how it is really billed, and flags clients who may be billed twice. Never changes a policy or an invoice.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-duplicate-clients
plugins.description: Finds client records that are the same person or business (exact, likely and possible duplicates) and different people who share an address or contact. Never merges or deletes a record.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-lapsed-policies
plugins.description: Finds policies cancelled, lapsed or expired in the last 90 days: non-payment cancellations still inside a reinstatement window, clients with no replacement policy, and policies shown active but past expiration. Never reinstates or advises.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-license-renewals
plugins.description: Tracks producer and staff licences by state: expired licences, continuing education short before expiration, renewals due, and states with no setting yet. State rules are settings your agency confirms; never files a renewal.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-loss-runs
plugins.description: Summarises carrier loss runs by account over five policy years: claims, incurred, loss ratio, large losses and frequency, year by year. Reads the loss runs you have; never requests them or judges a claim.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-missing-commissions
plugins.description: Finds policies you wrote or renewed that never showed up on a carrier commission statement, and the ones paid only on endorsements, with the commission you expected on each. Drafts a request to the carrier; never posts or sends.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-open-claims
plugins.description: Ages open claims: losses with no carrier claim number, claims with no update for weeks, claims open on policies renewing soon and claims open a long time. Never files, settles or comments on a claim.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-pending-endorsements
plugins.description: Follows every policy change a client asked for: not sent to the carrier, sent and not confirmed, or confirmed with a premium change that was never billed. Never sends a change or confirms one to a client.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-policy-checking
plugins.description: Checks each issued policy against what was bound, coverage by coverage: missing coverages, lower limits, higher deductibles, different premium or dates, and binders with nothing issued. Never binds or endorses.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-premium-finance
plugins.description: Watches premium finance agreements: notices of intent to cancel, installments past due or due soon, agreements not funded, and funding not passed on to the carrier. Never pays, reinstates or cancels.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-producer-retention
plugins.description: Works out retention by producer, line and carrier from your policy terms, by count and premium, with the lost policies and their reasons. Never contacts a client.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-producer-splits
plugins.description: Works out each producer's share of the commission the agency received (new and renewal percents, shared policies, house accounts) and compares it with the producer statement. Never changes producer pay.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-receivables-aging
plugins.description: Ages agency-bill receivables by client and producer, flags premiums the agency already paid the carrier but has not collected, and credit balances owed back to clients. Drafts a reminder; never sends, charges or cancels.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-renewal-remarket
plugins.description: Lists renewals coming due with no renewal review logged, the ones expiring soon with nothing done, and renewals that go up with no remarket logged. Never quotes, binds or recommends a carrier.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-return-premiums
plugins.description: Follows return premiums on agency-bill policies from the carrier's credit to the client: refunds overdue or due, refund checks not cleared, and direct-bill returns the carrier pays. Never writes a check or moves money.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-signed-declinations
plugins.description: Checks each active policy file for the signed documents your agency requires: applications, UM/UIM rejections, flood offers and declinations of coverage offered. Lists what is missing or unsigned; never sends forms or advises on coverage.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-trust-account
plugins.description: Reconciles the premium trust account: bank balance against premiums collected and owed to carriers, unexpected withdrawals, commission moved beyond what was earned, and remittances overdue or due soon. Never moves money.

plugins.name: fairpolicy-workers-comp-audits
plugins.description: Follows premium audits on workers comp and other auditable policies: audits not started, large additional premium, returns due, and payroll far from the estimate. Never disputes an audit or contacts the carrier.
